_note: Early-game guidance. Settlement voice, plain — these must be scannable in two seconds, so they are deliberately shorter and blunter than the chronicle or the cutscenes. Each has a title of a few words and one or two sentences. Prose only; src/guidance.ts owns when each is shown.

first_year.title: Food, first of all
first_year.body: Nothing else matters until the year's eating is covered. One pair of hands is standing idle — put them to a job, then end the year and see what the harvest brings.

first_building.title: Something to build with
first_building.body: Timber and stone are what everything after this is made of, and no one is cutting either. A Communal Garden is already within your means, and it feeds the settlement every year without asking for a worker.

find_stone.title: Stone is out there somewhere
find_stone.body: Your people will not walk more than two fields from the hearth, and there is no stone inside that ring. Send a scout to find some. When you do, a dirt path costs three timber and carries your reach one field further — you do not need the Long House to go and get it.

toward_long_house.title: Twenty-five souls
toward_long_house.body: The Long House needs a real community under it — twenty-five people. Keep them fed, keep spirits up, and take in the survivors who come. Everything civic on this island unlocks from that roof.
